whoFor: Companies that need to identify, record and file their persons with significant control (PSC) with the CAC.

benefits.title: Clarity on who counts
benefits.text: Each person's interest checked against the reporting rules.

benefits.title: A register that matches
benefits.text: Your PSC register consistent with your filings.

benefits.title: Updates on time
benefits.text: Changes recorded and filed when ownership or control changes.

whatYouReceive: A review of ownership and control to identify each PSC
Preparation and submission of the PSC filing with the CAC
A note of when the next update is due
whatYouProvide: Your ownership records, including any nominee or trust arrangements
Identification for each person with significant control
Your written authority for SCS to file
doesNotInclude: A promise of when the CAC will process the filing
Investigations into ownership you do not disclose
